# Deterministic orderings without the library (probe), then the library with only the pool's
# event-dependency reuse on (=1), with every table upload from pinned memory (64 staging slots, so the
# host seldom waits for one) and, interleaved, with the pageable uploads it always used.
probe.1
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.1
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.1
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.2
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.2
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.3
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.3
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.4
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.4
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.5
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.5
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.6
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.6
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.7
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.7
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_STAGING=1,FIDESLIB_PINNED_SLOTS=64.8
env:FIDESLIB_DEBUG_NO_XSTREAM_REUSE=1.8
